content: Mbɔr
Pɔl, ntööm a Yɛsu Klistɔ unsà ukwen a Nzam, akà baar abà u Ɛfɛsɔ abà bà Nzam anà bàlää amu Yɛsu Klistɔ:
Wɛy kab a ngway anà duu a Taaràbi Nzam anà Mwol Yɛsu Klistɔ màkäl anà bɛ.
Indiir aŋàbwaŋ kipɛ Nzam u mbwo a Klistɔ
Nsaak ikäl akà Nzam, Taarà Mwol abi Yɛsu Klistɔ! Nde kisaak mukipà nsaak a dweelà yanswà u du amu Klistɔ.
Kusà a nkyeer a mɛɛn, Nzam kisɔ̈ɔ̈l itaan mukal bànde u mbwo a Klistɔ, ntɔn bi ikäl bà in'kyɛɛl anà ikɔ̈ɔ̈n an'pɛl u mii ande. Unsà ukwen ande,
Nzam kilɔ̈ɔ̈n kusà mukal iywaaŋ nkà ande u mbwo a Yɛsu Klistɔ, mulab ukwen ande unsà ubwaŋ ande.
Abun, wɛy bi isyäŋà Nzam ntɔn kab a ntsà kipɛ nde amu Mwan ande wànkween.
Amu nde, u mbwo a an'kil ande, bi kàkyàtoo unsà isɔ, amu nde, bàkidwääl ibii abi, mulab un'naaŋ a kab a ngway a Nzam,
alà kikääb nde làŋàsöönà, mukipà an'yeerà manswà anà un'yɛnà wanswà.
Nde kipɛ mbwo muyöb ngyee a ukwen ande, ngyee kàlɔ̈ɔ̈n nde kusà unsà ubwaŋ ande, amu Klistɔ,
ntɔn mukölà ya u taaŋ a ntsüü: un'tüüb amu Klistɔ, nkyeer yanswà ayà u du anà ayà u mɛɛn.
Amu nde sye, bi kàwɛl kab làbi unsà an'kyän a mbuur afàsyen bya byanswà unsà ukwen ande, bi bisɔ̈ɔ̈l kusà,
ntɔn musyäŋà làkoo ande, bi baar kàsi làkyän kusà amu Klistɔ!
Amu nde sye, bɛ làkyàwem ndaa a ndandaa, Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ làfàlatswà mɔ̈ɔ̈. Amu nde sye, bɛ làsi làkwikilà anà bàlasi inyɛm a Dweelà In'kyɛɛl bàpɛ ilää,
mbööl a kwal abi tii u ntsuuŋ abi yà ntsüü ayà isàwal bi, ntɔn nsyäŋà a làkoo ande.
Ngyamàkà a Pɔl
Kyakin, mɛ sye, fà kàwem mɛ làkwikilà abɛ amu Mwol Yɛsu anà ukwen abɛ ntɔn aŋin'kyɛɛl banswà,
mɛ in'fàyɔn anki mufuur an'tɔɔn ntɔn bɛ, umpal in'fàlatà mɛ din u ngyamàkà amɛ.
Wɛy naa Nzam a Mwol abi Yɛsu Klistɔ, Taa aŋàlàkoo, kàlapɛ dweelà a an'yeerà anà là imɛɛy ntɔn bɛ lun'yöb ubwaŋàbwaŋ,
wɛy nde uduub mpem abɛ u pɛɛlà ande, ntɔn bɛ làyöb naa làkyän nà alà mwo unsà làbeel ande, naa un'naaŋ a làkoo ande wà aben, kwal ufàlakääb nde anà aŋin'kyɛɛl,
unkaak a ngwal a kölàköl nà nde we awà ntɔn ubwaŋ abi, bi aŋàlàkwikilà. Ngwal ande ayi, nde ya kàtwey unsà unkaak a ngwal ande wanswà,
nde ya kàpɛ akà Klistɔ mpal kun'wiiy nde uboo a akü, anà kun'bwääy u kɔɔ ande là ibaal u du,
udu a imfum kyanswà, ikɔ̈b kyanswà, unkaak a ngwal wanswà, imwol kyanswà anà ikɔb kyanswà ban'kwo mutà din, kà nà u mɛɛn mà mpɛl anki, wɛɛ sye anà u mɛɛn amà isàyà.
Inye, Nzam kàsi indiir byanswà ungyɛl a in'kɔl a Yɛsu anà nde kun'pɛ akà Ikööŋ ntɔn mukal un'tswe a indiir byanswà.
Ikööŋ kya kyà ndür ande, nde awà ufàyööl Nzam ŋakwo a barbar.
